source_text: Hiericho tubis sacerdotum subruitur. Ad tubarum sonitum muri corruerunt — virtus verbi Dei. Sacerdotes tubis canunt; arca praecedit. Sex diebus circuitus, die septimo clamor — sabbati mysterium et consummationis. Meretrix et domus eius salvantur signo coccineo.
pass_a_gloss: Jericho by-trumpets of-priests is-overthrown. At of-trumpets sound walls fell — power of-word of-God. Priests with-trumpets sound; ark goes-before. Six days circuit, on-day seventh shout — of-sabbath mystery and of-consummation. Harlot and house her are-saved by-sign scarlet.
pass_b_english: Jericho falls to the priests’ trumpets. At their blast the walls collapsed — the power of God’s word. Priests sound; the ark goes before. Six days of circling, on the seventh a shout — sabbath mystery and the end’s figure. The harlot and her house are saved by the scarlet sign.
